title: Interview: Why do we need a Sheikh?
body:
1.Why do we need a Sheikh? Is it not enough to follow the holy Quran?
Follow!…We need a teacher like in university. Sheikh is teacher… If the Quran was enough for these people
here why they are coming to me? You think a piece of wax from a beehive may give pleasure to you? If no
bees, these forms of honey without that liquid become honey? Bees running, collecting, eating, then giving
honey. You can do this? That is specialty of bees; it is not for man. Man is a much more perfect creature than
a bee, but we can’t make honey. It is for bees. May run through nature, eating, coming and giving that liquid
once again. What eating not coming and bringing in it. Eating, digesting, then that liquid becoming through
these bees as liquid honey. Putting in it and Holy Quran you may do - as example I am bringing bees - this is
also a big nature. Through the Quran you may find thousands of kinds of flowers and botanical plants, roses ?
but not everyone can be able from these words, becoming like honey to give to people. There is through
insects or animals world specialty for making honey, Allah the Creator granted to that bees, not to everyone.
So many kinds of bees, but not making honey but coming to eat honey. Quran is endless oceans and you can’t
be able to bring form that ocean what is necessary to people easily. But for Prophet sws that is his specialty. If
it was as they say or you say to me that if it is not enough Quran and why we follow a Sheikh, I am saying: If it
was enough or the right way Allah Almighty was not sending through Prophet and Prophet giving. No need to

say anything else. But Prophet was teaching; taking and giving. Must be!
2.You are guiding your Mureeds even though many of them don’t get the chance to meet you. How is it
possible?
This world is not only what you see. Now here there are waves or not? From satellite. You believe? You saw
it? How sending? Even coming to my room on my TV. Putting much more clear example: A big dish. If not
using, not coming. Even there are waves coming from the satellite, but not taking. They need this dish. From
space coming…??? Therefore heavenly revelation coming and if not Prophet’s hearts, can’t be reaching that
revelation to people. Must be this. And also- you see that dish in which direction? Must be towards Qibla!
Can’t be any other direction, impossible! Subhanallah! So many secret things that man is not knowing or it in
not true for them to teach new generation such things that belong to spirituality, because our teachings now
through East and West on material aspects, materialist principles. And material principles bring atheism.
Saying: No God. If you say something like this, they can’t answer. I say: Why putting this dish only toward
Kaaba everywhere? Because whole power coming on Kaaba…
3.The friends of Allah are supposed to be alive even after they die. How ?
Awliya reach real life through their material physical being. They reach through their short life a connection
with Heavens. Therefore their power is continuously, not coming down, because they have a connection with
heavenly beings. If no connection from real wires outside, meter, this light can be in here? If no meter, never
working. And through that there is a wire like hair, very thin, it is the symbol of connection. If it is cut down,
finished. They say: Fuse just blown. Every power quickly going out. You think power on that very thin wire
bringing this power here? Impossible. And Awliya, even they are so weak through their physical being, but
power coming through them. If you take them away, never coming that power from Heavens to earth. And
people think: We are through lights… They are blind people…
4. Are the Ashabu-l Khaf still alive or are they asleep?
Ashabu-l Khaf all unmarried people… but you are married… Looking to come with Mehdi a.s., making for
them Nika according to Preserved Tablet what is written for them… For Jesus also: Are you accepting to be
that one your wife? I am saying… Such things you don’t hear from East to West. It is a grant from Allah to you

to hear from spirituality…
5. It is said in the Quran that ‘the believers will see the Face of Allah’. Does Allah have a face?
If dying, never seeing. Dead people can’t see. Alive people may see. Allah has face? Who looking to Him, they
know… His Face not like yours. You think there is a face for the sun? Without face how can be sun? Blind sun,
blind moon? Can’t be…
6. It is said that ‘if you know yourself, you know Allah’. How can we get to know ourselves?
How you can be nothing? Your being is big veil to see… You can see yourself without a mirror? You need a
mirror! If not, you can’t recognize yourself. You may think that you (have been) are in a place never finding
there any mirror. And someone is making a photograph from you and bringing it to you, showing (and
saying): “You know this one?” “No…” If no mirror, you can’t see yourself and this mirror can catch only your
outlooking, but your inner spiritual being can’t be seen through these mirrors. It needs mirror that have been
granted divinely lights through themselves and they may show you. Or for example if you are here in a dark
room, you can’t see yourself nor anything (else). If a person is coming with his lights, he may show you
everything around yourself, then he may show to you: Look, you recognize who is this one?” You say: ”Who is
that one? I don’t know…” Long way…
7.Can the love between a man and a woman help achieve the divine Love?
Must be. Look, Allah Almighty making two kinds from man: Man and woman; just created to complete each
other. Men represent the perfection, divinely perfection and power of Allah Almighty, Kemal Tajalli. Women
have been granted from Jamalu-llah, from His endless Beauty Oceans. Kemal and Jamal, perfection and
beauty, if not coming together, (they are) not in perfection. When coming and joining each other, coming
perfection. But people are not understanding and think that men on their ways, another kind of
creature?????? And women, so many no mind women say: “Why we are created women?” Perfection and
power for men, they are representing (that). Beauty and latafat, gentleness for women. If not coming
together, not coming a perfect creature. Women through men going to be Fana, finishing. How beauty
coming and entering in reality????of perfection of man, and then reality????of perfection of man coming and
entering through the beauty and gentleness of women. When coming, a new appearance that each of them

going to reach top of pleasure. Man without woman… S.Adam a.s. was created first and he was in Paradise,
running around, but no satisfaction or contentment for him, as if asking something. Whole Paradise and its
beauty was not giving to him a contentment and pleasure. He was asking something else. Then the unit of
time of the blinking of his eye was enough- so short time, no one can know except Allah Almighty- and he was
looking in front of him a beauty sitting, that representing beauty from beauty oceans of the Lord Allah
Almighty. And he was saying: ”Come!” “No”, she was saying. S.Adam calling her… ”No, you come…” she was
saying. And finally he went… Therefore it is not true for women to go after men, but men- it is their structure,
they must go to ask women to reach to them. But not women! Nowadays everything is mixed up… Your value
is so high! S.Adam was looking and calling… refusing…. then he was going… These are all heavy subjects, but
they make them so light for your understanding level… If going up a little bit, no one can understand…
countless levels…
8. Advice for women.
Advice for women? Don’t run after men! Enough that they give to you your real value. Don’t make your value
down, under the feet of these foolish men. You are precious more than rubies and emeralds, pearls and
diamonds… But now these shaitan’s representatives in all countries use women as a black stone under their
feet. I am not accepting! Keep your honour!
Difference? You can’t ask how. If you need cleanliness, Allah Almighty is preparing the ways of cleanliness for
men and women…
If man was higher it was going to be seen when S.Adam was saying: “Come here” and she was saying: “No,
you come!” Means: their level up, higher. Prophets from men, enough. But women may learn and improve
and develop themselves over common level of mankind. Prophecy is something else. Beauty needs protection
and perfection protecting beauty. Therefore you can’t (be prophets). Pearl through shell, not outside. If
outside, finished, no value. You are like diamonds, pearls. If putting outside to clean roads, to come ????? to
be ?????? or judge, no value for you, no! What Allah Almighty granted to you from high value, you are making
it under your feet when you are working outside. You are pearls through homes, not outside.
Divorce - darkness of this life ???? Kelam, holy command of Islam, Allah Almighty saying: ”When you marry,
it is for all life here and Hereafter.” But after a while making against, saying: Divorce. They are liars, shaitans,

men or women… Be patient…
Lefke, März 2003 Transcribed by Khairiyah Siegel
